adminFields.title: Field configuration
adminFields.subtitle: Configure field labels, input types and allowed values. Edit Current Location to manage its locations.
adminFields.usageNote: Labels, help text and allowed values saved here are used by equipment forms.
adminFields.locationAdded: Location added. It is now available in equipment forms.
adminFields.addOptionHint: Add option, then Save to make it available for this field. Existing equipment is unchanged.
adminFields.locationsHint: Add, edit or deactivate choices for this field. Location changes are saved immediately.
adminFields.errorDropdownNeedsActiveOption: A dropdown needs at least one active option.
adminFields.label: Label
adminFields.locationsSubtitle: The choices available for Current Location.
adminFields.labelHelpDbOnly: Label and help text only affect the DB record — the equipment form shows its own bilingual dictionary for this field.
adminFields.missingValueCount: {{count}} active equipment records currently have no value for this field.
adminFields.switchToDropdownHint: Switching to Dropdown lets you set a fixed list of choices below. Existing values that don't match a new list will still display correctly on old records.
adminFields.optionCannotRemove: An option that may already be in use cannot be removed here — turn it off instead.
adminFields.errorDropdownNeedsOption: A dropdown needs at least one option.
adminFields.errorOptionNeedsValueAndLabel: Every option needs a value and a label.
adminFields.systemFieldsHint: Fixed fields the application depends on. You can relabel, reorder, require or hide them, but never delete them or change their type.
adminFields.customFieldsHint: Fields you create for attributes the built-in system fields don’t cover. Values are stored per equipment without a database migration.
adminFields.customFieldsWillAppear: Use "New custom field" to add one.
adminFields.fieldKeyHint: A permanent internal identifier (lowercase letters, numbers, underscores). Cannot be changed after creation.
adminFields.confirmDeleteCustomField: Delete this custom field? Its stored values will be removed from every equipment record. This cannot be undone.
adminFields.dropdownOptionsAfterCreateHint: For a Dropdown field, add its options after creating it by opening Edit.
adminFields.blockedCreatorsWarning: {{count}} user(s) can create equipment but can't edit this field: {{names}}. While it is Required, they can't create any equipment.
adminFields.grantEditToBlocked: Also let these users edit this field
adminFields.askAdminToGrant: Ask an administrator to give them edit permission on this field.
adminFields.newRequiredFieldWarning: Nobody can edit a new field yet. While it is Required, users who create equipment are blocked until they may edit it.
adminFields.grantEditToCreators: Let every user who can create equipment edit this field
adminFields.deleteValueCount: {{count}} equipment record(s) have a value for this field. It will be removed from them (the removed values are kept in the audit log).
adminFields.customFieldDeletedCount: Field deleted. Value removed from {{count}} equipment record(s).

adminMasterData.title: Master data
adminMasterData.subtitle: Equipment Types, Statuses, Levels, Locations and Departments — admin-managed reference data used throughout the app. Deactivate a value to stop offering it for new equipment; existing equipment keeps displaying it normally.
adminMasterData.typesHint: Equipment Type — referenced by equipment.type_id. Any type can be the parent of any other.
adminMasterData.statusesHint: Equipment Status. A status with "Requires Remark" makes the Remark field mandatory the moment it is selected.
adminMasterData.levelsHint: Equipment Level in the production line.
adminMasterData.locationsHint: Physical or logical locations — buildings, floors, or a vendor site during a repair.
adminMasterData.departmentsHint: Department — a fixed list users pick from in Account settings, instead of free-typing their own (so "Test Eng" and "Test Engineering" can't end up as two different values for the same department).
adminMasterData.calibrationSettingsHint: How many days before its due date a calibration counts as "Due Soon" instead of "Valid".
